verdict.rationale: The evidence points to a public GitHub repository at github.com/keycloak/keycloak, and a community comment implicitly groups Keycloak with FOSS projects, so its source appears publicly readable. No evidence item names the license or confirms it is an OSI-approved open license, and the GitHub item describes a Node.js adapter rather than the server source itself. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of the open-source license (e.g., Apache 2.0), evidence that the core server source is in the public repo, independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
